description: Asks up to five AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) one question with live web search and reports, per engine, whether a brand's website is cited, at which position, which competitors are cited instead, and the sources, plus a 0-100 visibility score. Suited to AI search visibility (GEO, AEO) checks and brand monitoring. $0.05 per engine asked; the engines parameter selects them, all five when omitted ($0.25).

answer.description: true (default): include each engine's full answer text. false: a smaller response without it.

brand.description: Your website domain, e.g. "hubspot.com" (a full link is reduced to the domain). The brand counts as cited when an engine lists a page of this site among its sources or names the brand in its answer.

competitors.description: Up to 5 competitor domains separated by commas, e.g. "salesforce.com,pipedrive.com". Each gets the same checks and a place on the leaderboard.

country.description: 2-letter country code for Google AI Overviews (default us), e.g. gb, ca, au.

engines.description: Engines to ask, separated by commas: chatgpt, perplexity, claude, gemini, google-ai-overviews. Default: all five (google-ai-overviews only with language en). Fewer engines answer faster.

language.description: Language of the question and the answers (default en).

query.description: The question as people ask an AI assistant, 3 to 300 characters, e.g. "best CRM for small business". One question per request.

name: ai_visibility_check
title: AI search visibility: is a brand cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews
